meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把访谈或播客视频叠加动态字卡与图文框,直接产出可发布成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有一段访谈或播客录像,想快速加上设计好的动态字卡和图文框再发布。
copy.tagline_en: Overlay timed graphic cards and lower-thirds on your podcast or interview video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have an interview video needing timed graphic overlays before publishing.

howto.what: 给它一段完整播放的口播、访谈或播客视频,Claude 会按本地 Whisper 转写的逐字稿,设计并逐张写出定时图形卡片——标题、下三分之一、数据标注、引述、侧栏、画中画——叠在原片上,渲染成 MP4。原片在下面照常播放。
howto.when: 当你提到 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics” 等关键词,或要求把已有口播视频包装上屏图形时触发。它不做普通字幕,那种需求走 embedded-captions;意图不明时先走 hyperframes。

say.text: 把这段访谈视频加上图形卡片,做成 9:16 竖版
say.note: 先抽音频,用本地 Whisper 转写

say.text: 给这个播客片段加上下三分之一和引述卡片
say.note: 卡片在对话里逐张设计后渲染成 MP4

say.text: 把这条口播包装一下,用 4:5 画布,至少 5 张卡片
say.note: 卡片数量按时长和信息密度推算

howto.what_en: Given an existing talking-head or podcast clip, Claude adds timed graphic cards — titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to a local Whisper transcript, then renders MP4.
howto.when_en: Fires on “graphic overlays”, “on-screen graphics”, or packaging an existing video. Plain subtitles go to embedded-captions; unclear intent goes to hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Add graphic cards to this interview video and make it 9:16
say_en.note: Extracts audio, transcribes with local Whisper

say_en.text: Give this podcast clip lower-thirds and quote cards
say_en.note: Cards are designed in chat, then rendered to MP4

say_en.text: Package this talking-head clip on a 4:5 canvas, at least 5 cards
say_en.note: Card count comes from duration and density
